## Phase: 32 - Memory MCP Server: Nanaclaw + Consolidation

### Memory MCP Server Architecture
from: [[decision:memory-mcp-server-architecture]]
retrieved: 2026-05-03

- RRF fusion: score = alpha/(k + bm25_rank) + (1-alpha)/(k + cosine_rank), alpha=0.4, k=60. Tie-breaking: trust > strength > recency
- Source enum values: USER_EXPLICIT, OBSERVED, INFERRED, IMPORTED — Phase 32 adds CONSOLIDATED
- Cosine >0.90 auto-reinforce, 0.85-0.90 warn, <0.85 no action (dedup thresholds)
- _get_conn(scope) routes "project" and "global" to different DB paths — scope="all" fan-out not yet implemented

### Phase 32 Approach
from: [[decision:phase-32-nanaclaw-consolidation-approach]]
retrieved: 2026-05-03

- Consolidation: cosine > 0.80 clustering (different from 0.90 dedup threshold), fail-closed on Qwen failure (skip cluster, don't concatenate)
- Migration type mapping: user→fact, feedback→correction, project→fact, reference→custom. Original type preserved as `source-type:<type>` tag
- Migration trust: feedback→high (explicit corrections), all others→medium. source=imported
- Prune criteria: active=1 AND trust=low AND strength=1 AND (age > 180d OR access_count < 2)

### Phase 31 Sidecar Pattern (reused by consolidator)
from: [[phase-31-memory-mcp-sidecar]]
retrieved: 2026-05-03

- SidecarConfig: enabled, endpoint, model, timeout_ms=3000, max_candidates=10
- SidecarClient.verify_candidates() for binary relevant/not-relevant filtering
- Extractor forces trust=low, source=inferred — deterministic boundary on all LLM output
